messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1719999000 — Canary alert: hallucination rate spike on hosted-api model 'redwood-open-0.9.2-canary' (>5x baseline). Auto-annotation: increased customer complaints in last 3m. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/incidents/1719999000
oncall-sre: Got the page, I'm on it. Paging @april_ml and @sam_prodeng for model/deploy context.
carla_support: We got 2 customers on support with similar complaints — hallucinated legal-sounding advice. No PII exposure reported yet.
april_ml: Looks like the new decoder tweak landed in canary yesterday. Repro locally with small prompts, weird token bias after step ~50. Investigating.
sam_prodeng: @jordan_reliability can we flip the canary flag to 0% while we triage? Prefer kill-switch over full rollback if it's just canary.
jordan_reliability: Agreed if traffic is isolated. What's canary traffic weight?
oncall-sre: Canary at 3% across hosted region-us-west. For safety we can flip. I'll coordinate the rollback path if we need to revert the release.
april_ml: Confirmed reproducer with short prompt. Probable decoding logit bump in revision r202. Recommend kill-switch first.
oncall-sre: Executing feature flag flip to remove canary routing now.
deploy-bot: @oncall-sre requested feature-flag toggle: /ff toggle canary_route_redwood_0_9_2 0 — started
oncall-sre: Toggle complete. Traffic -> baseline model. Monitoring for error/hallucination decrease.
carla_support: Customers updated, one is holding while we roll back. They asked for ETA.
sam_prodeng: Parallel: prepare manual rollback doc in case flipping flag is insufficient. Steps: (1) drain canary nodes (2) revert image tag to v0.9.1 (3) post-deploy smoke. Anyone want to run if needed?
april_ml: I'll be on standby for quick patch if this is a regression we can hotfix. For now flip seems to have immediate effect in my local repro.
jordan_reliability: Monitoring shows hallucination metric back to baseline within 90s of flag flip. Good sign.
oncall-sre: Observability shows request error/quality back to normal. No new pages.
carla_support: Thanks — letting customers know it's mitigated and we'll follow up with root cause.
sam_prodeng: Still, runbook: capture canary logs and the exact prompts. @april_ml, can you grab a sample set and push to /incidents/1719999000/artifacts?
april_ml: Done. Uploaded model logs, attention weights, and token probabilities. File links pasted in #eng-ml.
deploy-bot: Audit: feature-flag toggle by oncall-sre (uid:oncall-sre) at 1719999078.
jordan_reliability: Suggest we leave flag off for next 2 hours and then canary a tiny fraction after fix. Also schedule a canary replay job against baseline to ensure no false negatives.
oncall-sre: Agreed. I'll set a temp policy: canary_rate=0 until 1740000000 or manual override.
carla_support: We'll send customers a post-incident note once root cause determined and plan for rollback/hotfix communicated.
april_ml: Initial root cause hypothesis: decoding temperature schedule interplay with recent logit-scaler change. We'll attempt a quick revert of that single change and run unit tests. If that passes, plan a targeted canary for limited traffic.
sam_prodeng: If a hotfix is ready, coordinate with me for a controlled rollout. If not, manual rollback steps are ready.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1719999000 — Status: mitigated (customer impact reduced). Pager cleared.
jordan_reliability: Great work team. Postmortem owner: @april_ml. Please include timestamped logs, reproducer, and decision timeline.
april_ml: Will open postmortem doc and assign follow-ups. Tentative RCA: r202 logit-scaler change.
oncall-sre: Closing thread here, leaving channel for any followups. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
